lang.ability.jojorpg.anubis_learning_blade.de: Remembers every attack - it never loses twice.
lang.ability.jojorpg.anubis_selective_intangi: Its blade passes through walls to cut what is behind.
Possesses whoever draws it and makes them a master swordsman.
lang.ability.jojorpg.atum_binary_soul_reading: Reads the soul - a yes or no answer can never be hidden.
lang.ability.jojorpg.atum_soul_steal.desc: Draws the soul into a doll.
lang.ability.jojorpg.bastet_magnetic_attracti: Whoever touches it becomes a magnet; metal flies at them.
lang.ability.jojorpg.bastet_magnetized_debris: Metal objects rocket towards the target.
A chop that can take a head off.
lang.ability.jojorpg.cream_void_bite.desc: Its mouth leads into the void.
lang.ability.jojorpg.cream_void_sphere.desc: Swallows Vanilla Ice and itself into the void and erases everything in their path.
lang.ability.jojorpg.dark_blue_moon_barnacles: Barnacles that drain the victim's strength.
Calls Dark Blue Moon out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.dark_blue_moon_underwate: Lightning-fast strikes, strongest in the water.
lang.ability.jojorpg.death_thirteen_dream_wor: Drags sleepers into its dream world, where no other Stand exists.
Calls Death Thirteen out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.death_thirteen_scythe_re: Its scythe reaps in the dream.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ebony_devil_anger_empowe: The more Devo hates, the stronger it becomes.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ebony_devil_doll_possess: Possesses a doll and stalks its prey with a razor.
lang.ability.jojorpg.ebony_devil_manifest.des: Calls Ebony Devil out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.emperor_homing_bullets.d: Bullets that change course in mid-air.
lang.ability.jojorpg.emperor_point_blank_summ: Summons the gun and fires point-blank.
lang.ability.jojorpg.empress_parasitic_growth: Grows out of the victim's body, feeding on them.
lang.ability.jojorpg.empress_vein_bite.desc: Bites and drinks from the host.
lang.ability.jojorpg.geb_drowning_grip.desc: Seizes the victim and drags them down.
lang.ability.jojorpg.geb_vibration_sonar.desc: Reads every footstep through the sand.
lang.ability.jojorpg.geb_water_claw.desc: Water slashes from a distance, faster than a bullet.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hanged_man_light_manifes: Travels between reflections at the speed of light and strikes from the mirror.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hanged_man_manifest.desc: Calls Hanged Man out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hanged_man_reflection_am: Leaps out of the victim's own eye.
Slashes with the blade hidden in its wrist.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hermit_purple_divination: Spirit photography and thoughtography reveal where enemies are.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hermit_purple_manifest.d: Calls Hermit Purple out - or back.
Channels the Ripple through the vines - deadly to vampires.
Thorny vines lash out and entangle.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_20_mete: Strings stretched in a 20-metre radius fire Emerald Splash at whatever touches them.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_anatomy: Slips inside a body and controls it like a puppet.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_coiled_: Unravels into tentacles that ensnare a distant target.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_emerald: Fires a torrent of energy shaped like emeralds.
lang.ability.jojorpg.hierophant_green_manifes: Calls Hierophant Green out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.high_priestess_diamond_t: Teeth claimed to be as hard as diamond.
Calls High Priestess out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.high_priestess_mimicry_a: Hides as any mineral object and strikes from inside it.
lang.ability.jojorpg.holys_stand_manifest.des: Calls Holy's Stand out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.holys_stand_thorny_vines: Vines without a fighting spirit to control them; they weaken their user.
lang.ability.jojorpg.horus_icicle_rain.desc: Drops giant icicles on the enemy.
lang.ability.jojorpg.jonathans_stand_manifest: Calls Jonathan's Stand out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.jonathans_stand_spirit_p: DIO divines with the vines of Jonathan's body, like Hermit Purple.
lang.ability.jojorpg.judgement_three_wishes.d: Grants a "wish": clay copies of the departed rise to fight.
lang.ability.jojorpg.justice_fog_puppetry.des: Controls anyone with an open wound through the fog.
lang.ability.jojorpg.justice_wound_strings.de: Pierces holes through the victim's body.
lang.ability.jojorpg.khnum_transfiguration.de: Changes Oingo's face into anyone else's.
lang.ability.jojorpg.lovers_brain_spores.desc: Builds pain-spawning clones in the victim's brain.
lang.ability.jojorpg.lovers_pain_link.desc: Burrows into the brain: any pain Steely Dan feels, the host feels.
lang.ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_crossfire_: Splits the ankh into a spread of flames that surround the target.
lang.ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_life_detec: A flame compass reveals every living thing nearby.
lang.ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_manifest.d: Calls Magician's Red out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_pyrokinesi: Engulfs everything around in heat that can melt steel.
lang.ability.jojorpg.magicians_red_red_bind.d: Ropes of fire bind the target.
lang.ability.jojorpg.osiris_soul_steal.desc: Tears out the soul of whoever loses a bet and seals it in a poker chip.
lang.ability.jojorpg.osiris_the_wager.desc: Challenges the opponent to a game.
lang.ability.jojorpg.sethan_age_reversal.desc: Its shadow turns whoever it touches back into a child.
lang.ability.jojorpg.sethan_shadow_reflection: The shadow stretches across the ground.
lang.ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_armor_off: Sheds its armour to reach full speed, leaving afterimages.
lang.ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_flame_ske: Skewers coins and flames in a single thrust.
Calls Silver Chariot out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_plus_anub: Dual-wielding Anubis, it overwhelms even Star Platinum.
lang.ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_rapier_ba: Barrages of thrusts before the enemy can react.
lang.ability.jojorpg.silver_chariot_shooting_: Launches the rapier's blade like a bullet.
lang.ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_bullet_cat: Catches bullets and knives between two fingers.
lang.ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_manifest.d: Calls Star Platinum out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_ora_ora.de: An extremely fast, precise barrage of punches.
lang.ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_star_finge: Extends two fingers to stab from just outside its reach.
lang.ability.jojorpg.star_platinum_superhuman: Inhales with superhuman lung capacity, dragging enemies (and fog Stands) in.
Stops time for about two seconds - and moves inside stopped time.
lang.ability.jojorpg.strength_iron_crush.desc: Crushes the prey with the ship's hull.
lang.ability.jojorpg.strength_ship_manipulati: The ship itself - pipes, chains and rigging close in on the crew.
lang.ability.jojorpg.sun_light_ray.desc: Fires rays of light from the sky.
lang.ability.jojorpg.sun_solar_flare.desc: A flare that sets the sand ablaze.
lang.ability.jojorpg.sun_solar_heat.desc: Scorches the desert like a second sun.
lang.ability.jojorpg.tenore_sax_illusion_maze: Turns DIO's mansion into an endless maze of illusions.
lang.ability.jojorpg.tenore_sax_manifest.desc: Calls Tenore Sax out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.tenore_sax_phantom_walls: Corridors and walls that are not really there.
lang.ability.jojorpg.the_fool_manifest.desc: Calls The Fool out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.the_fool_sand_blast.desc: A blast of sand that blinds.
lang.ability.jojorpg.the_fool_sand_decoy.desc: Moulds a sand double while Iggy slips away.
lang.ability.jojorpg.the_fool_sand_glider.des: Spreads into wings of sand to glide.
lang.ability.jojorpg.the_world_knife_throw.de: A fan of silver knives - they hang in stopped time.
lang.ability.jojorpg.the_world_manifest.desc: Calls The World out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.the_world_muda_muda.desc: A flurry of punches stronger and faster than Star Platinum's.
Drives a hand straight through the opponent.
lang.ability.jojorpg.the_world_road_roller.de: ROAD ROLLER DA! Drops a steamroller on the enemy.
lang.ability.jojorpg.the_world_time_stop.desc: Stops time for five seconds; only DIO moves.
lang.ability.jojorpg.tohth_fateful_link.desc: The prophecy seals the target's fate.
The comic book's prophecies always come true.
lang.ability.jojorpg.tower_of_gray_manifest.d: Calls Tower of Gray out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.tower_of_gray_tower_need: Pierces with its needle tongue at blinding speed.
lang.ability.jojorpg.wheel_of_fortune_car_ram: Rams the enemy with the car.
lang.ability.jojorpg.wheel_of_fortune_gasolin: Sprays gasoline that bursts into flame.
lang.ability.jojorpg.wheel_of_fortune_iron_sp: The car sprouts spikes and claws.
lang.ability.jojorpg.wheel_of_fortune_manifes: Calls Wheel of Fortune out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.yellow_temperance_appear: Takes on the appearance of anyone.
lang.ability.jojorpg.yellow_temperance_manife: Calls Yellow Temperance out - or back.
lang.ability.jojorpg.yellow_temperance_physic: Absorbs every blow - an armour of flesh-eating jelly.
lang.item.jojorpg.disc.lore: A memory disc holding a Stand. Push it into your head to make the Stand yours.
lang.item.jojorpg.stand_arrow.lore: An arrow carved from a meteorite. Those it pierces awaken a Stand - or die.
